name: Trade Prince Gallywix
guide_text: In the early game, buy every [[River Skipper||122092]] and [[Patient Scout||97604]] as they generate you money. In the lategame, Gallywix relies on [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] to cycle lots of cards to ramp up economy. You must play a cycle composition with this hero, so try not to go Beasts or Undeads.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up for 5-7 gold because it's a value generating buddy.
